# Baremetrics API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Authentication
Cookie-based (intercom-session-tq0xuv22) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /content-tools-menu/api/v1/tools-menu/has-permission-json` — Check if the current user has permission for a tool.

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /_hcms/forms/embed/v3/form/{formId}/{formId}/json` — Retrieve JSON data for a specific HubSpot form.
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific resource by ID.
- `GET /api/public_data.json` — Fetch public data in JSON format.
- `GET /v2/cf-location` — Retrieve the Cloudflare location data.
- `GET /web-interactives/public/v1/embed/combinedConfigs` — Get combined configuration data for embedded interactives.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /_hcms/perf/v2` — Send performance data to HubSpot.
- `POST /wa/` — Send data to the 'wa' endpoint.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Baremetrics's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Baremetrics data without official API access
- Automate actions on baremetrics.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Baremetrics frontend uses
